_comment: TEST DATA ONLY. Two checkpoints are taken verbatim from the concept doc's own examples (the public clock and the gargoyle). The other two are placeholders invented to exercise trivia/puzzle challenge types in tests. None of this has been walked or verified in Barcelona - do not use it for a real event before completing the operational checklist in the doc (walk the loop, check GPS accuracy, opening hours, safety plan).
